name: Seri Pacific Hotel Kuala Lumpur
detail: Nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, is the 5 star business class Seri Pacific Hotel Kuala Lumpur. Located 10 minutes away from the city bustling Golden Triangle, it offers easy access to major tourist attractions. Boasting 560 rooms including suites and the premier rooms, the hotel is located next to Malaysia 1st premier convention complex, the Putra World Trade Centre (PWTC) and opposite Putra Mall. The hotel is easily accessible by public transport and is within a walking distance to the Putra Light Rail Transit (LRT) station and the PWTC Komuter Station. An exceptional hotel with high level of hospitality that goes beyond your normal range of luxurious hotel, Seri Pacific Hotel Kuala Lumpur is an apt ambassador of the legendary Malaysian charm and friendliness, accompanied by uncompromising world-class standards. It’s your home away from home.

name: Impiana KLCC Hotel
detail: Hotel Impiana KLCC is a very good hotel with a perfect service. The location is absolutely great, being in the middle of Kuala Lumpur, directly in between shopping malls Suria KLCC and Pavilion. If you are travelling in Malaysia by car, Impiana is a good hotel to stay because they have free parking and a good parking lot next to the hotel. There is almost nothing negative about this hotel. Good price / quality ratio! We booked this hotel without and meals, so I cant say about the quality of the food.. but looking at their restaurant it must have been pretty good.. busy every evening! You don't need any meals from the hotel if you think its too expensive, you can get the best food at almost every corner of the street in Kuala Lumpur.

name: Hotel Sentral KL @ KL Sentral Station
detail: It was a great 3 days staying at sentral Hotel. The location was really near to the KL sentral station (10 minutes walk) which the train can bring you directly to the airport and less than a minute walk (across the street) to the monorail station which can bring you anywhere you want to. There is ABC restaurant near the monorail station so you can have your food easily, pharmacy (if needed) maybe 100 meters away, and also a small store near the hotel to buy your needs. Our Taxi driver said that Hotel Sentral Area was Kuala lumpur Little India. The hotel was good although it has old air conditioner system. It has a very clean bathroom with amenities (except tooth brush and tooth paste)and also hot and cold water on their shower. their are also an electric water boiler with coffee, tea, and 2 bottles of water as a compliment every day. Also they have safety deposit box if you need to safe your stuffs. But most of all staying at this hotel for a low budget (like me) was a very pleasant day in Kuala Lumpur. The Hotel need RM 50 for deposit at your check-in and can be refunded when you check out. Thank you Sentral Hotel, Brickfield, KL Sentral

name: The Bed KLCC
detail: I had a 13 hour layover in Kuala Lumpur on my way to Kathmandu, so I decided to go out the airport and see Petronas Twin Towers and have a decent place to sleep for the night as I arrived around 10 pm from Hongkong. I actually booked at The Bed in advance and I just paid around 800PHP via Agoda for one night! I took the female solo pod which consists of a shoe locker outside, a dental kit, towel, a locker beneath the bed and a bed with cover. That is already great because the accommodation is quite good, cozy, and good for solo traveller like me. LOCATION: It took me around 45 minutes to 1 hour to get to The Bed from the airport giving that the KLIA Expres travel time to KL Sentral is 28 to 30 minutes. From KL Sentral, get a (coin) ticket via RapidKL to Dang Wangi station (if you don't mind walking around 10 minutes to hotel),turn left,take the overpass,walk straight until you saw Bukit Nanas station. Cross the street. The nearest station from the hotel is Bukit Nanas station,which I took from the hotel to KL Sentral that cost me 3.70 MYR. I don't saw in the map that Bukit Nanas station will be passed by using Gombak line from KL Sentral because it is in the Titiwangsa line which you can also take,just walk from KL Sentral to Mid Valley station. The Bed is in the Vortex building, beside 7-11 so you will be able to see it clearly. RECEPTION: I checked in near midnight, and the receptionist is a Filipino and also some other Filipinos are checking in that time. The check in and check out was smooth and incredibly fast. INTERNET CONNECTION: Wi-Fi is reliable and good. I can still do some video calls while at the washroom and any part of the hotel. FOOD: The food was not that good, without variety. Breakfast was only a Malaysian rice (with peanuts,dried fish and half hard boiled egg) and breads. The drinks was water, coffee and tea. I hope they will add more in the future.
